title: Weighted Laplacian Flow: A Deterministic Particle Flow with Exponential Convergence
summary: We introduce weighted Laplacian flow (WLF), a deterministic particle-flow framework for sampling from a target distribution known only up to normalization. The proposed method evolves the logarithmic density ratio through a transport equation and determines the particle velocity from a target-weighted Poisson problem, resulting in a nonlocal and kernel-free mechanism for redistributing mass.
